plugins.description: Turn documents/data/ideas into consulting-style high-density PPTX. Four phases: deep research → evidence analysis → visual blueprint → PPTX generation + QA. Unique: blind-read review, claim tracing to evidence sources, and CJK font assertions. Works with any agent-capable tool (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode).
